{{Top|leg}}
The '''Blood Code''' was a part of [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] genetics that resulted in each birthing producing one male and one female [[Youngling/Legends|child]]. However a flaw in the Blood Code sometimes resulted in male [[Twin/Legends|twins]] being born. The occurrence was rare, with only two hundred documented cases in two millennia. One of the male twins would have a genetic flaw that had a 33% chance they would develop sociopathic tendencies. The Snivvians eventually used [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] to stabilize the Blood Code and prevent twin male births.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>
